summary: Baozun filed a Form 6-K containing five consecutive Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns (Oct 12-16, 2026) recording share repurchases. The filings show ongoing buybacks of WVR ordinary shares (HKEX code 09991), with the opening balance cited at 160,910,522 issued shares and 13,373,981 treasury shares as of October 8, 2026. No price per share, aggregate program size, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed in the excerpt. The structure reflects an issuer returning capital via open-market repurchases; the risk-arb angle is limited, with watch items being daily buyback pace and treasury-share accumulation relative to any stated mandate.
